facts.fact: Home Affairs says it is reviewing an MOU with the Department of Health to let the National Department of Health use DHA's Verification Service for identity, birth and death data.
The Minister of Home Affairs's reply treats the National Population Register as the current register, with registered South Africans put by the questioner at around 80%.
